description: Everything translated from an English source: the dashboard and CLI catalogs of the non-English locales, the docs/i18n mirrors with their hash ledger, and the real-translation ratchet measured on them. A feature PR edits only the English source (src/i18n/messages/en.json, bin/cli/locales/en.json, the English docs); these files are rewritten once per release by release:refresh-derived, by a translation wave, or by the scheduled mirror-refresh PR. The compact error-boundary catalogs (src/i18n/global-error-messages) are companions, not a category: they are regenerated from the catalogs on every build, a translation-only PR may carry them, and a feature PR that edits en.json publicSystem.globalError must still be able to regenerate them.

categories.why: A feature PR adds or rewrites keys in en.json only; at runtime the dashboard falls back to English (src/i18n/request.ts deepMergeFallback) until the locales are completed. Catalog edits carried by feature PRs conflicted on every merge (48 open PRs touched the same ~43 catalogs on 2026-11-13).
categories.refreshedBy: release:refresh-derived → syncUiKeys({ catalog: "ui", pruneExtra: true, rewrittenSinceRef, translate: true }) in scripts/i18n/sync-ui-keys.mjs (CLI: node scripts/i18n/sync-ui-keys.mjs --rewritten-since=<ref> --translate-markers --batch-size=40), or a translation wave branch

categories.why: A feature PR adds CLI strings to bin/cli/locales/en.json only; the CLI falls back to English until the locales are completed.
categories.refreshedBy: release:refresh-derived → syncUiKeys({ catalog: "cli", pruneExtra: true, translate: true }) in scripts/i18n/sync-ui-keys.mjs (CLI: node scripts/i18n/sync-ui-keys.mjs --catalog=cli --translate-markers --batch-size=40)

categories.why: The 66 translated mirrors of the English docs and their hash ledger are rewritten from the English source; a feature PR edits the English doc only.
categories.refreshedBy: npm run i18n:run -- --files=<doc> on a translation wave branch (docs/i18n-*), the scheduled i18n-mirror-refresh workflow (chore/i18n-mirror-refresh), or release:refresh-derived

categories.why: The real-translation ratchet is measured on the locale catalogs, so it only moves when they do; on a feature PR the ratio gate runs in release mode (SKIP) and there is nothing for the PR to tighten.
categories.refreshedBy: npm run i18n:check-ratio:update after the catalogs are refreshed (release:refresh-derived or a translation wave)
